# Disaster Solutions Navigator — Copilot Instructions

## Project purpose

Disaster Solutions Navigator is an interactive ConstructSteel web prototype that helps users navigate from a city hazard to infrastructure mitigation solutions.

The agreed navigation has five levels:

1. Hazard Area
2. Infrastructure
3. Mitigation Solutions
4. Solution Explorer
5. Detailed solution information on the ConstructSteel website

The current prototype focuses on an earthquake scenario, a city model, selectable infrastructure, mitigation-solution hotspots, animations and an embedded Sketchfab solution viewer.

## Technology

- JavaScript ES modules
- Three.js 0.180
- Vite 7
- HTML and CSS
- Node.js 22
- VS Code Dev Container
- No React or other UI framework

Commands:

```bash
npm run dev
npm run build
```
